name: Galada Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Galada Finance Ltd provides financial and lending services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GFL is a Chennai based company which is engaged in the business of lending across retail, SME and also commercial customers, with 
a significant presence in the urban and rural India. The co. is registered as a non systematically important non deposit taking 
non-banking financial company

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 165 days to 112 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.29% over last 3 years.
